messages.author: abee1286f226e441
messages.subject: knitr and Eclipse
parts:
Hi all,
I am having a fantastic time watching knitr develop - it seems that
every day, someone has asked for - and received! - a new feature that
I can use. I am working in the Eclipse environment, and am finding
knitr far more Eclipse-friendly than was pgfSweave. In particular, the
ability to knit tex documents means that I can make use of Eclipse's
excellent outlining and word-wrapping features for the tex document
(the lack of outlining for rnw was particularly annoying) and the R
documents also have a nice outline feature in addition to the object
list and other good things.

I see mention of support for RStudio, so I thought I should say that
Eclipse already plays quite nicely with knitr.

Thanks again for all your good work, Yihui.
